registration.intro: Choose the in-person 5K, 1-mile fun run, survivor option, or virtual participation through the official RunSignup page.
registration.deadline: Race-day 5K registration and packet pickup close at 7:45 AM; fun-run registration closes at 8:45 AM.
registration.price_note: The official race page notes that $25 of the race entry fee may be refunded for participants who fundraise at least $250.

runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you register.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for the Motherwalk & Run 5K and 1-mile fun run.

items.label: Ways to participate
items.value: 5K, 1-mile fun run, survivor options, and virtual participation

items.label: Packet pickup
items.value: Trak Shak Homewood before race day; Homewood Central Park race morning
items.detail: Pre-race packet pickup and registration are listed for Wednesday and Friday from 3:00–6:00 PM at Trak Shak Homewood. Race-day pickup opens at 6:30 AM at Homewood Central Park.

items.label: Awards
items.value: 5K overall and age groups; fun-run finisher medals
items.detail: 5K awards include top overall and age groups. Fun Run participants 14 and under receive a finisher medal.

items.label: Shirts
items.detail: Shirt sizes are not guaranteed; shirts are available for the first 500 registrants.

items.label: Refunds and transfers
items.value: No refunds; transfers allowed by deadline
items.detail: Refunds are not available, and bib-number transfers must be completed by the listed deadline.

items.label: Cause
items.value: Benefits the Norma Livingston Ovarian Cancer Foundation

story.title: A Birmingham-area race morning for ovarian cancer awareness.
paragraphs: Motherwalk & Run brings runners, walkers, survivors, teams, and supporters to Homewood Central Park for a 5K, 1-mile fun run, and virtual participation options.
Race proceeds benefit the Norma Livingston Ovarian Cancer Foundation, with team fundraising and donation paths built into the official registration experience.

items.label: VENUE
items.title: Homewood Central Park
items.description: Race-day registration, packet pickup, the start, and awards are listed at Homewood Central Park in Homewood, Alabama.

items.label: PACKET PICKUP
items.title: Trak Shak Homewood
items.description: Pre-race packet pickup and registration are listed at Trak Shak Homewood, 1839 18th Street South.

items.label: MISSION
items.title: Run, walk, or fundraise
items.description: Participants can join individually or as teams and support the Norma Livingston Ovarian Cancer Foundation through fundraising and donations.

faqs.question: Where is race-day packet pickup?
faqs.answer: Race-day registration and packet pickup open at 6:30 AM at Homewood Central Park.

faqs.question: When does the 5K start?
faqs.answer: The 5K is listed for an 8:00 AM start after announcements and survivor recognition.

faqs.question: When does the 1 Mile Fun Run start?
faqs.answer: The 1 Mile Fun Run is listed for a 9:00 AM start.

faqs.question: Are refunds available?
faqs.answer: Refunds are not available; transfers must be completed by the listed deadline.
